```{r}
v <- venn.diagram(
  x=list(C_activities$Teaching, C_activities$`Creative Work`, C_activities$Teaching),
  category.names = c("Teaching", "Creative Work and Research", "Service"),
  na = "remove",
  filename = 'cvenn.png',
  output = TRUE
  )

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(v)
lapply(v, names)
lapply(v, function(i) i$label)

v[[5]]$label  <- paste(setdiff(Celia_activities$Teaching, C_activities$Teaching), collapse="\n")  
# in baa only
v[[6]]$label <- paste(setdiff(C_activities$Teaching, foo)  , collapse="\n")  
# intesection
v[[7]]$label <- paste(intersect(foo, C_activities$Teaching), collapse="\n")  
```

celven \<- ggvenn(x, show_elements = T, label_sep = '\\n',

fill_color = brewer.pal(name="Set2",n=3))

pdf(file = "/Users/amdubose/OneDrive - Syracuse University/Professor Name (VPA), Performing Arts Research Impact/vizualizations/venn.pdf",

width = 8,

height = 6)

plot(celven)

dev.off()

```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)

AA <- c(C_activities$Teaching)
BB <- c(C_activities$`Creative Work`)
CC <- c(C_activities$Service)

x<- list(Teaching=AA, "Creative Work"=BB, Service=CC)

celven <- ggvenn(x, show_elements = T, label_sep = '\n',
       fill_color = brewer.pal(name="Set2",n=3))

pdf(file = "/Users/amdubose/OneDrive - Syracuse University/Professor (VPA), Performing Arts Research Impact/vizualizations/venn.pdf",
    width = 8,
    height = 6)

plot(celven)

dev.off()
```
